title: Specsavers — EN/PT/ZH (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 98bpm brushed drums gentle comedy self-deprecating English Portuguese Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
It was Corey's birthday morning, twenty-three photos sent
Wilma's finest album, every angle that she meant
Twenty faces, twenty smiles, lined up wall to wall
Then she noticed something — bottom three weren't Corey at all

[Verse 2 — Português]
Meu Deus disse ela — essas três de baixo não são Corey [Oh dear she said — those bottom three aren't Corey]
São Pete, são Pete, definitivamente Pete, que história [They're Pete, they're Pete, definitely Pete, what a story]
Desculpa disse Mum no grupo pelo engano cometido [Sorry said Mum in the group for the mistake made]
Parece que preciso ir à Specsavers — fui advertida [Seems I need Specsavers — I've been warned]

[Chorus — English]
Happy birthday Corey, sorry about the mix
Bottom three were Pete, dear — isn't that a fix
Gotta go to Specsavers, haha, love you all
The gardens still growing, even when I drop the ball

[Bridge — 中文]
Corey生日快乐，抱歉搞混了 [Happy birthday Corey, sorry about the mix]
下面三张照片是Pete亲爱的 — 真是个意外 [Bottom three were Pete, dear — isn't that a fix]
我得去Specsavers了，哈哈，爱你们所有人 [Gotta go to Specsavers, haha, love you all]
花园还在生长，即使我犯了错误 [The garden is still growing, even when I drop the ball]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pete didn't mind, he liked being in the album
Corey laughed so hard the phone fell off the bench

[Outro — EN/PT/ZH]
The gardens still growing
O jardim continua a crescer [The garden is still growing]
花园还在生长 [The garden is still growing]
Gotta go to Specsavers
